name: Birding
description: Sri Lanka holds over 30 endemic bird species. Nandana, a Field Ornithology Group member, leads birding across the island's rainforests, highlands and dry-zone parks.

name: Wildlife Safari
description: Leopard, elephant, sloth bear and more, tracked across Wilpattu and Yala National Parks.

name: Trekking
description: Nature walks and hill-country trails, from Ella Rock to Horton Plains and the Sinharaja rainforest.

name: Culture & History
description: Ancient cities, cave temples, the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, and Kandy's cultural traditions.

name: Adventure Sports
description: White-water rafting, canyoning and zip-lining around Kithulgala's rainforest river.

name: Beach
description: Coastal leisure time on the south coast, paired with Galle's Dutch Fort.
